The Mad Mage summoned more monsters than he could control, and his room, beneath the Ancient Temple of Thais, filled up with creatures. You get the key to the room from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin (solving a riddle and giving him apples), clear the room and open the chests with the {item:Hat of the Mad}, the {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and the {item:Star Amulet}.

In another chest in the room items appear once a day: {item:Energy Ring}, {item:Silver Dagger}, {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}, {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes}, {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars} and food.
You will pass through the Mad Mage's room on the way to Mintwallin. First you have to go to Mintwallin to get the key, then you return to the room.
Take the 7 {item:Red Apple|Red Apples} on the very first descent so you do not have to go back to the surface.
The Mad Mage's room has a {creature:Dragon} and several {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}: bring enough potions.
This is the path from the surface to the Mad Mage's room. It is also the start of the route to Mintwallin.
Go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, north of **Thais**. Go down **two floors** and go as far **north** as you can.
Go down to the floor of the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. Follow the path in the image **east** and **south** and go down the stairs.
Path on the Rotworm floor to the stairs
On this floor there are lots of {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}. Run over them and use an {item:Antidote} afterwards, or use {spell:Destroy Field} to clear a path. Then go down one more floor.
Follow the path in the image **east** and **north**. Go down the hole marked with a circle on the map. Down there you will find some {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}.
Watch out for the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} on this floor.

Go **south** through the leftmost passage. Go up through the hole to a small room and go up again to another room. There go to the end of the passage and go down through the hole to a small room, and go down again.
Go up twice and down twice
Go **south**, then **west**, then **north** and turn **right** towards the level door.
The key to the Mad Mage's room is held by {npc:A Prisoner}, locked up in Mintwallin. Follow the route to Mintwallin ({wiki:Route:Mintwallin}) from the Ancient Temple.

Follow the path from section 1 up to the hole of the {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}. After killing them, follow the maps (blue line, from A to B): there are no monsters on this stretch, except perhaps a {creature:Rat}. When you reach two staircases, go down either one and walk a few steps **west**: you are at the Mintwallin gate.
In **Mintwallin**, go to the barracks **south** of {npc:Markwin} to get the {item:Key 3620}, which opens the prisoner's cell.

Go to the Mintwallin prison and talk to {npc:A Prisoner}. Say {key:hi} and {key:riddle}. The riddle asks in what order a Knight, a Druid, a Paladin and a Sorcerer can cross a bridge when chased by orcs. The right answer is {key:PD-D-KS-P-PD}.
There is more than one possible solution to the riddle, but only this one is accepted. It comes from the book {item:The Riddle (Book)}, which is on a bookcase northeast of the Mad Mage's room.
Swap the apples for the key
With the 7 {item:Red Apple|Red Apples} in your inventory, say {key:yes} four times. You receive the {item:Key 3666} (silver key).

To go back to the Mad Mage's room, leave through the Mintwallin gate, go up one of the two staircases and retrace the maps in reverse (from B to A) to the Cyclops area; then follow the path from section 1 to the level door.

If you want to leave Mintwallin for the surface, there is a shortcut through a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (red line on the maps), then following the blue line to the exit. Careful: the hole in the red circle is "blind" (you fall through it but cannot climb back up with a rope), so you cannot return to Mintwallin that way.

Go back to the level door of section 1 (level 40) and go down the stairs. The room has at least one {creature:Dragon}, a {creature:Giant Spider}, a {creature:Bonelord}, 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, a {creature:Ghoul}, a {creature:Scorpion} and a {creature:Skeleton}. Clear the room.
Monster room and locked door to the southeast
CAREFUL! Do not go down without potions: the Dragon and the Demon Skeletons together are dangerous for low levels.
Go **southeast** and open the locked door with the {item:Key 3666}.
Go up and open the chests

Go through the door and up the stairs. You face 3 more {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. The rewards are in the {item:Chest (Quest)|chests} in this room: {item:Hat of the Mad}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and {item:Star Amulet}.

Explore the room: once a day, items such as {item:Energy Ring}, {item:Silver Dagger}, {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}, {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes}, {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars} and food appear in a chest.

Go down the stairs, go back through the door and go up the stairs to the level door. Then retrace the path from section 1 in reverse: go up through the holes (use the {item:Rope}), cross the minotaur floor and the {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} floor again, go up the stairs of the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor and the two floors of the Ancient Temple until you come out north of Thais.
